sections.label: I · My story
sections.h2: Raised on a Langley farm, selling the Fraser Valley since 2015

items: I grew up on a 40-acre farm in Langley. That's where I learned how land, barns, wells and the ALR actually work, and it's why farm and acreage sales are a big part of my business today.

I've lived in South Surrey for years, and spent two years in Downtown Vancouver's Yaletown. So I know both sides: suburban family neighbourhoods and city condo living. That helps a lot when clients are moving between the two, whether they're upsizing to a detached home, downsizing or investing.

Today I live in Brookswood, Langley. I keep close track of neighbourhood trends, zoning changes, land use plans and new development, because that's what gives my clients an edge when they buy or sell.

I work with buyers and sellers across South Surrey, White Rock, Langley, Surrey, Cloverdale, Ladner, Tsawwassen and the rest of the Fraser Valley: condos, townhomes, detached homes, acreages, farms, land and mobile homes. I don't do property management or appraisals. I help people buy and sell homes.

What clients tell me they value most: clear communication, straight advice on price, hard negotiating, and marketing that gets their home seen. I'm hands-on from the first showing to completion day, and I especially enjoy helping first-time buyers, families moving up and investors.
